tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full details for an id from search: team:<id>, player:<id>, league:<league key> or match:<id>. Returns the title, the full text, and the football-mania.com url.

tools.name: get_day_fixtures
tools.description: All football matches on a date: results, live scores and kick-off times, grouped by competition (biggest competitions first). A busy day has 1000+ matches, so filter by country or league_key when you can.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Same as get_league_fixtures; accepts the competition key with or without the _small suffix.

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: All-time head-to-head record of two teams: wins, draws, goals, their recent meetings and the next scheduled meeting. Teams by ID or name.

tools.name: get_league_fixtures
tools.description: Fixtures and results of one competition (league or cup): latest results, matches in play and upcoming matches of the current season, or one round. For the table use get_standings.

tools.name: get_live_scores
tools.description: Football matches being played right now, worldwide, with score and minute, grouped by competition (biggest competitions first). Optional filters by country or league key.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match in detail: score, status, goals, cards and substitutions with minutes, line-ups, team statistics (possession, shots, corners…), injuries, form, standings of both teams, match report and head-to-head record.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: A player: club, position, age, nationality, market value, statistics per season and competition, injuries, transfers and honours.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Current standings (league table) of a competition: position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals, points, form and the qualification or relegation zone. Group-stage competitions return every group.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: A team: recent results and upcoming fixtures, league positions, season statistics, squad with appearances and goals, injuries, transfers, coach, stadium and honours.

tools.name: get_top_scorers
tools.description: Top scorers of a competition this season: goals, penalty goals, team and nationality.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Connectivity check: echoes the message back.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find teams, players and competitions by name. Returns results with an id (team:…, player:…, league:…) for fetch or the other tools, a title, a football-mania.com url and a short summary; teams include their last and next match.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
